bodies.name: Proxima Cen b
bodies.nativeSurface: No resolved planetary surface image or measured terrain; 2025 source artwork is artistic context only.
measured: Radial-velocity planet: period 11.18465 days, minimum mass 1.055±0.055 Earth masses; 2025 multi-instrument confirmation.
Proxima is an active M5.5 dwarf; 2025 analysis adopts effective temperature 2900±100 K and radius 0.141±0.021 solar radii.
modelled: RV-derived semimajor axis 0.04848 AU; equilibrium temperature 218 K assumes Bond albedo 0.3 and redistribution, not measured surface temperature.
Stellar/planet coplanarity, spin locking, atmospheric survival and climates are hypotheses. No measured radius is available; catalogue radii may be mass-radius estimates.

The illustrated disc size uses adopted radius and semimajor axis. Blackbody-derived flux from these adopted values differs from the paper luminosity-based incident flux; neither is calibrated image photometry.
unknown: True planetary mass/inclination, physical radius, atmospheric composition/pressure, water inventory, surface chemistry, geology, spin and cloud cover.
Surface colours, thermal structure and magnetic field are not measured; a nominal habitable-zone orbit does not establish habitability.
assumed: One water-poor airless silicate/iron rocky scenario: subdued charcoal/grey/taupe terrain, no ocean, life, atmospheric clouds or glowing lava. Composition and every geographic feature are chosen, not observed.
Proxima b terrain differs artistically from the other planet; it does not encode a measured difference in mineralogy or crater age.

60° hypothetical rectilinear view with an artist-chosen observer and stellar elevation. Peach/cream bright photosphere and warm reflected ground light are approximate under exposure and adaptation, not a pure red disc.
No dated flare, spots or companion-star alignment is invented. Alpha Centauri A/B are omitted from the chosen sky direction; their positions are not inferred.

references.title: Suárez Mascareño et al. 2025, b/d RV confirmation and adopted stellar properties
Turbet et al., atmospheric and climate scenarios, not measured climate
Navarro-Piñeiro et al. 2026, stellar activity and possible star/planet interaction
IAC 2025 system artwork and source credits

contextImages.description: 2025 artist interpretation of the Proxima b/d system accompanying NIRPS confirmation; not observed terrain, composition or calibrated stellar colour.
contextImages.terms: IAC credited source artwork; project owner supplies reuse basis. Original artist credit retained.

surfaceMap.projection: 2:1 equirectangular, north up; illustrative east-positive longitude with no measured surface frame or geographic registration.

bodies.promptBrief: Individual rocky scenario albedo map under neutral lighting and corresponding airless sky view under a 2900 K M dwarf. No Earth analog continents, clouds or life; stellar disc approximate within 60 degree field.
